representation_plans.encoded_information: Horizontal and vertical magnitudes with explicit signs and axis labels.
representation_plans.decisive_feature: Direction remains encoded by sign while like axes align.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Translate, add, subtract, or isolate matching components.
representation_plans.prose_advantage: The ledger makes sign preservation and axis alignment inspectable.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Axis labels and signs are always printed; no correct option is highlighted.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: A committed component choice diagnoses the first observable sign or operation divergence.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A semantic ordered-pair statement supplies the same signed inputs and requires the same component operation without stating the result.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Ordered pairs wrap as text; axes remain adjacent to values.

representation_plans.encoded_information: Compass direction, magnitude, and signed-axis relation in semantic text.
representation_plans.decisive_feature: Opposing arrows create signed rather than unsigned component contributions.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Translate arrows into signed components before combining.
representation_plans.prose_advantage: The structured statement exposes direction-to-sign translation.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Every direction and magnitude is explicit; color and position carry no meaning.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: No drag interaction; answer selection carries the operation.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Each arrow is stated as a magnitude plus compass direction, requiring the same sign translation and resultant computation.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Direction statements wrap within the content column.

representation_plans.encoded_information: Reference angle and named side roles/lengths in semantic text.
representation_plans.decisive_feature: Opposite and adjacent are relative to the selected angle; hypotenuse is stable.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Choose and apply the ratio containing the known and target sides.
representation_plans.prose_advantage: The structured relation keeps side roles explicit without a decorative figure.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Labels name givens only; no ratio or answer is highlighted.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: Semantic radio response preserves the relationship selection.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: The prompt states the reference angle and names each side’s role and length without supplying the ratio or result.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Side-role statements wrap without horizontal scrolling.

representation_plans.encoded_information: Named side ratio and unknown isolation.
representation_plans.decisive_feature: The equation includes exactly the known and requested quantities.
representation_plans.prose_advantage: The equation preserves intermediate algebraic state.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Math is rendered as text with spoken operators; no answer cue.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: Answer choice commits the equation or bounded value.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Plain-language ratio plus linearized equation text.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Equation wraps at operators without side scrolling.

representation_plans.encoded_information: Compass axes plus labeled into-page and out-of-page symbols.
representation_plans.decisive_feature: Ordered perpendicular directions determine the requested output.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Assign, align, curl, read, and apply charge sign when stated.
representation_plans.prose_advantage: The semantic direction key keeps perpendicular axes and page depth explicit.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: ⊙ and ⊗ always include text labels; no color or position alone carries meaning.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: No inaccessible hand-drag simulation; the same spatial inference is required from labeled directions.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: The prompt names all vectors using east/west/north/south/into/out directions and asks for the missing output; it does not narrate the hand result.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Direction-key entries stack in one semantic column.

representation_plans.encoded_information: First input, second input, requested output, and sign condition.
representation_plans.decisive_feature: Input order and charge sign remain explicit.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Map each stated direction to its hand-rule role and infer output.
representation_plans.prose_advantage: The ordered list prevents role swapping while preserving spatial reasoning.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Ordinal labels identify inputs but do not state the output.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: Semantic choices require the same output inference.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: The representation is already semantic text.
